questions.stem: The mean of 5 numbers is 12. Four of the numbers are 8, 10, 15 and 14. What is the fifth number?
questions.explanation: Sum of all 5 numbers = mean x count = 12 x 5 = 60. Sum of known numbers = 8 + 10 + 15 + 14 = 47. Fifth number = 60 - 47 = 13.

questions.stem: A class of 20 students has a mean test score of 64. Another class of 30 students has a mean of 72. What is the overall mean for all 50 students?
questions.explanation: Total for class 1 = 20 x 64 = 1280. Total for class 2 = 30 x 72 = 2160. Overall mean = (1280 + 2160) / 50 = 3440 / 50 = 68.8. The common error is averaging 64 and 72 to get 68, which ignores the different class sizes.

questions.stem: After 8 matches, a cricketer's mean score is 45. After the 9th match, the mean drops to 42. What did they score in the 9th match?
questions.explanation: Total after 8 matches = 8 x 45 = 360. Total after 9 matches = 9 x 42 = 378. Score in 9th match = 378 - 360 = 18.

Six data values have a mean of 10. Each value is multiplied by 3 and then 5 is added. What is the new mean?
questions.explanation: When all values are multiplied by k then increased by c, the new mean = k x (old mean) + c = 3 x 10 + 5 = 35. This works because the mean follows the same linear transformation as the data.
